digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure, git version floor enforcement
propositions: The merge-tree regression added for bug 8185 requires Git 2.38+ for git merge-tree --write-tree capability but the codebase does not declare or enforce a Git version floor.
A runtime skip guard would silently prevent the regression from running on older clients, creating a vacuous test that reads as coverage when it does not execute.

The Git 2.38+ floor must be declared in a single-sourced file, enforced with a fail-not-skip abort in pytest_configure before collection, and documented consistently in README, CONTRIBUTING, local-dev-env.md, and CI workflows.
The enforcement must include capability verification and mutation checks to prevent the guard logic from drifting or becoming vacuous through module splits or renames.
